line.en: Give the cats a job. They run a shift and hand you a silly report: who sat on the keyboard, what is in the commit log, and whether it ships. A parody. Nothing leaves your device.
line.he: נותנים לחתולים משימה. הם עובדים משמרת ומגישים דוח מצחיק: מי ישב על המקלדת, מה ביומן השינויים, והאם משחררים. פרודיה. שום דבר לא יוצא מהמכשיר.

limit: It is a joke: the reports are written in advance and are not real software advice.

works: Give the cats a job; six of them run a shift
A silly report: who sat on the keyboard, the commit log, the version, whether it ships
Same job gives the same report, so it can be shared
next: A share card as a picture
Hebrew jokes checked by native speakers
later: A weekly shift report for a real team, as a joke they opt into
en.ask: What is the funniest thing a cat has done to your work?
